strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute opening range, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle, then switch to the 1-minute chart and wait for price to break one of those levels with a fair value gap. After price retests the fair value gap, enter when the retest candle is engulfed in the direction of the break.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop just beyond the deepest point traded into the fair value gap, with one tick of breathing room. Take profit at a fixed 3:1 reward-to-risk target and otherwise do not micromanage the trade.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for retest into the fair value gap, then wait for the retest candle to be engulfed before entry
variants.transcript_quote: first we want to wait for a retest of the fair value gap... then we wait for this retest candle right here to get engulfed

strategies.name: opening_range_fvg_limit_entry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute opening range, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle, then switch to the 5-minute chart and wait for price to break a level and form a fair value gap. Instead of waiting for a retest confirmation candle, place a limit order on the fair value gap so entry triggers when价
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop just beyond the first candle of the three-candle fair value gap pattern. Take profit at a fixed 2:1 reward-to-risk target and do not micromanage the trade.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: set a passive limit order on the fair value gap instead of waiting for a retest engulfing confirmation
variants.transcript_quote: instead of waiting for a retest, we're actually going to set a limit order on the FVG

result.enumeration_note: Two distinct strategies are taught because the entry mechanics and exits differ: the scalp uses retest-plus-engulfing confirmation with a 3:1 target, while the day-trade uses a passive limit entry on the FVG with a 2:1 target.
